summary.text: Jack Zibluk is the Democratic candidate for the Georgia State Senate, District 53, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously ran in the 2026 special election for the same seat, finishing second in the March 10 general election and losing the April 7 runoff to Republican Lanny Thomas.

paragraphs.text: Zibluk was the Democratic nominee for Georgia House of Representatives District 1 in 2024, losing the general election to incumbent Mike Cameron, 80.3% to 19.7%.
In the March 10, 2026 special general election for Senate District 53, he received 27.0% of the vote, behind Thomas at 38.7%, and the two advanced to a runoff.
Thomas won the April 7, 2026 special runoff with 68.7% to Zibluk's 31.3%.
Zibluk then advanced from the Democratic primary for the regular election on May 19, 2026.
